title: Denis Villeneuve Volumetric Atmosphere and Generative Texture Grain

sources.name: arxiv.org
sources.topic: Diffusion model noise scheduling for grain

volumetric_architecture.concept: Atmosphere as physical structure (fog, dust, smog)
volumetric_architecture.lighting_physics: Light must travel 'through' matter, creating visible beams (god rays)
volumetric_architecture.scale_through_obscurity: Using atmospheric haze to purposefully obscure distant details, implying infinite scale

textural_brutalism.surface_detail: Concrete weathering, sand grain physics, industrial decay

noise_scheduler_tuning.grain_simulation: Injecting specific Gaussian noise distributions at final diffusion steps to mimic Kodak film stocks

depth_haziness.z_depth_fog: Conditioning generation with depth maps where far-field density > near-field
depth_haziness.color_grading: Desaturated palettes (orange/teal) applied at latent generation level

generative_upscaling.risk: AI upscalers often 'clean' texture; Villeneuve style requires preserving 'dirty' industrial textures
generative_upscaling.technique: Texture-aware upscaling trained on brutalist architectural datasets
